title: Le troisième siècle dans la Vallée des Baux : les fouilles de la partie basse et de l’émissaire oriental des moulins de Barbegal
version: Revue archéologique de Narbonnaise 33, pp. 387–439. Publisher OCR of printed pp. 389 and 436–437.
lineage: Primary excavation report for the lower building and eastern outlet. Philippe Leveau also coauthored the later 2018 and 2024 carbonate studies. Those studies share earlier archaeological chronology even where they contribute new observations.

passages.locator: p. 389, introduction; p. 436, Conclusion, first paragraph
passages.quote: du IIIe s. à la première moitié du IIe s.
passages.note: The authors explain that the excavations revised the construction date from the third century to the first half of the second century.

passages.locator: p. 436, Conclusion, paragraph on ceramics at the eastern outlet
passages.quote: Son début ne coïnciderait pas avec la construction de l'usine
passages.note: The excavators interpret the outlet pottery as accumulating after construction, perhaps in connection with a modification of the outlet.
